title: GSE Joint Cyclic Gap Simplex V2 corrected zero-training readiness
purpose: Correct V1's undefined low-concentration angle authority and missing phase-observability contract by adding proper phase likelihood, binding phase concentration into refusal, and evaluating circular rotation in distribution/resultant space.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 corrected zero-training readiness over the exact V1 population/rows; no checkpoint, threshold, C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User delegated autonomous best-method selection and requested continuous execution without repeated approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated five-frame causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed Joint Cyclic Gap Simplex V1 readiness failure.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.fit: No fit. Re-audit all C01-C08 metadata and the exact same eight deterministic real rows.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Exact V1 population and rows; no performance sampling.

teacher.source: Sealed 180-bin continuous exit bearing/width/profile plus local axis and global geometry.
teacher.use: Sensor-azimuth ordered targets enter only cyclic-relabel invariant phase/gap/geometry losses; no identity.
teacher.valid_mask: Unchanged exact peak, width and global geometry masks.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid images only for eight real rows.

split.historical_pollution_audit: V1 metrics identify a contract defect only; no weights or outputs are reused.

methods.main: V1 joint phase+gap representation plus proper circular phase likelihood and phase-concentration refusal. Distribution and unnormalized resultant are authoritative under rotation; degree bearing/geometry at near-zero phase concentration remain reported diagnostics.
methods.baseline: V1: all population, closure, gradient, uncertainty and real backward checks passed; random-init phase mass rotation was 1.40e-9 while undefined atan2 bearing was 0.0072deg and sampled geometry 1.97e-4.
methods.fallback: If phase likelihood ordering/gradient, low-phase refusal, distribution/resultant rotation, closure or real backward fails, stop the joint gap route before training.

acceptance.joint_set: Positive gaps close exactly and collapsed gaps receive corrective gradient.
acceptance.phase: Correct phase proper NLL below uniform below wrong; uniform target gradient is corrective.
acceptance.uncertainty: Known-error proper scale optimum and set confidence bounded by phase concentration.
acceptance.symmetry: Phase mass/resultant, gaps/scales and authoritative batch tensors at most 3e-5; undefined low-concentration degree angles remain diagnostics.
acceptance.real_batch: Finite forward/loss/backward with explicit phase likelihood on one-to-four exits.

failure_policy: Fail closed. Preserve V1 failure. Do not change population, Teacher or test isolation. PASS authorizes only a training Data Card.
retention: Retain V1/V2 summaries, selected rows, figures/source, logs, RUN_STATE and seals.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU metadata audit plus eight-row forward/backward
